reddit.title: Explore the New Campaign in Provincia: Five Territories Beyond the Basin
reddit.body: We're excited to share our latest devtalk about the campaign in Provincia! In Tutorial 2 · Conquest, players will navigate a locked home valley and unlock five unique territories through strategic battles. Each territory offers distinct rewards and challenges. Check it out here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/five-territories-beyond-the-basin?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=five-territories-beyond-the-basin

steam.title: New Campaign Update: Five Territories Beyond the Basin
steam.body: We're excited to introduce Tutorial 2 · Conquest in Provincia! Players will start in a locked home valley and work to conquer five territories. Each territory presents unique rewards and strategic challenges. Learn more about how to expand your colony and the new gameplay mechanics in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/five-territories-beyond-the-basin?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=five-territories-beyond-the-basin
